desc:
🚪 You're on door duty tonight. Check every guest, catch the Sneaks and decide who gets into the party.

🆔 Check IDs: photo, birthday, height and the shiny star
🕵️ Spot the Sneaks: fake IDs, wrong photos, three kids in a trench coat
🙅 Turn them away and slam the window shut
🎧 Keep the party going: DJs, smoothies and a packed dance floor
🧽 Clean up the mess before the hype drops
⭐ VIPs, rush hours and weird guests every night
👯 Team up with friends from the lobby
🆙 Earn coins, unlock gear and new rooms, pick your class

Every night gets busier. How long can you keep the line moving?
